reasons: Only re-exports names; there is no logic here that could fail.

terms.meaning: Making a name from one file available from another file, so callers have a single import point.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Public list of evidence types
sections.what: Collects the evidence data types from the contracts file so other code can import them from this package. Its export list states which names are official.
sections.why: Likely reason: one import point for the rest of the app.
sections.watch_out: A type added to the contracts file must also be added here, or other code cannot import it from this package.

summary: Public entry point for the evidence data types, re-exporting them from the contracts file.
purpose: Gives the rest of the app one import location for evidence types.
why: Likely reason: keeps other code from needing to know the internal file layout.
how: 1. Imports the evidence types from the contracts module. 2. Lists them in the public export list so they are the official names of this package.
inputs: None. This file only re-exports names.
outputs: The evidence types: ConflictStatus, EvidenceBundle, EvidenceProvenance, EvidenceRecord, ExtractionMethod, NormalizedBoundingBox, ReviewStatus, SourceKind, SourceReference and TruthState.
risks: A new type added to contracts but not listed here will not be reachable through this package.
debug: If an import of an evidence type fails, check that the name is in both the import list and the export list here, then check the contracts file.
